propositions: A rejected tickets-branch auto-push succeeds locally and reports success to the caller while the push is silently dropped, violating the documented contract that every write propagates immediately and that failures warn rather than fail silently

The rejection-reason substring classifier (regex _NON_FF) is over-broad; it matches 'rejected' in policy-decline responses, misrouting terminal failures into the retry path and discarding the stderr that names the reason

The PUSH_PENDING divergence signal is computed only during explicit 'rebar fsck' on the pull path, never consulted by any write path, so an eight-hour accumulated backlog re-announces identically on every subsequent write rather than escalating

Ticket event payloads (comments, transitions, creates) are never scanned for secrets on write; gitleaks runs only on code, leaving a gap where agents routinely paste raw environment output containing credentials
